classification.difficultyReason: Source Mastery question requiring perpendicular diagonal bisection and Pythagoras’ theorem to find a rhombus side.

inlines.text: The length of the diagonals of a rhombus is 24 cm and 18 cm.
Find the length of each side of the rhombus.

answer.worked:
The diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at right angles, forming four right-angled triangles. Each triangle has perpendicular sides of $24\div2=12\text{ cm}$ and $18\div2=9\text{ cm}$. Each rhombus side is a hypotenuse. By Pythagoras’ theorem,
$$\begin{align*}l^2&=12^2+9^2\\l^2&=144+81\\l^2&=225\\l&=\sqrt{225}\\l&=15\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
